D1_cache_read_restriction.question: Why does writing at the early layer work where writing at a later layer fails: because the facts are processed by the layers between them, or because question tokens need to read fact-bearing keys/values in the lower layers?
sources: native (receiver states for the complete facts)

conditions.A_early: write at d20; the prefix cache is kept as computed
conditions.B_write_at_cut: write at the cut layer L in {d35, d50, d65}; layers <= L keep neutral keys/values by construction
conditions.C_early_restricted: the same prefill as A, then the prefix keys/values of every layer <= L (L in {d35, d50, d65}) are replaced by those of the neutral prefix; layers > L keep A's values. Question tokens are processed normally with this cache.
conditions.references: no message; the complete facts as padded public-layout text

built_in_checks: C with L = d20 must be byte-identical (cache fingerprint) to A, because a write at the output of layer d20 does not change keys/values at layers <= d20
C with L = last layer must reproduce the no-message answers exactly
cached vs complete forward agreement for the A and B arms (<= 0.05 max logit difference, equal parse)
D1_cache_read_restriction.caveat: C mixes keys/values from two computations, so it is an intervention with a cross-layer inconsistency; it localizes where fact information must be available, not a unique mechanism.

decision_rules.processing_suffices_at_L: C - B >= 20 points AND A - C <= 10 points, with the C - B family-bootstrap lower limit > 0
decision_rules.lower_layer_reading_needed_at_L: A - C >= 20 points with lower limit > 0

D2_matched_layout_direction.question: Where does the gap between reusable and scene-specific representations arise: in the layout/name/position mismatch of the generic fitting contexts, in the co-occurrence of the other facts, or in delivery itself?
receivers: glm-4-9b (primary: native 66.7% vs fitted 8.3% at d35 in R1)

representations.matched: per scene and fact: the scene's own neutral prompt (real names, layout, slot) with only that fact word in its slot, minus the same prompt with the word's tokens replaced one-for-one by the neutral filler token; read at the word-final token at the write layer; written at the same target position as fixed (gamma 1). A diagnostic, not a reusable method.
representations.native: receiver states for all complete facts read in the same public format, copied by (object, slot)
representations.text: the complete facts as padded public-layout text

D2_matched_layout_direction.interpretation: Operational gaps with paired family-bootstrap intervals, not a causal decomposition into independent mechanisms.

endpoints: four-answer (joint) success on 92 scenes (family-macro, as in R1); coverage; the logged correct-vs-incorrect alias logit gap as an auxiliary diagnostic only
ci: paired cluster bootstrap over development families, 20,000 draws x 3 seeds (20260924-6), enclosing interval
numerics: FP32 eager, TF32 off, batch 1, greedy, budgets 64/256 (as R1)
not_claims: no claim about new receivers until the depth scan exists for them
